name: collaboration-accounting
description: Accounts for decision-changing collaboration observations and routes them into immediate skill creation, existing-skill revision, a named candidate, continued observation, settlement, or retirement. Applies when materially meaningful work exposes a reusable collaboration affordance, an upcoming skill receives new evidence, or skill recursion needs a release decision.

contract.what: A light stewardship pass that turns working observations into one proportionate skill-lifecycle route.
when: Material work reveals a reusable collaboration move, friction in an active skill, a promising skill billet, overlapping skill territory, or a repeated meta-level pass whose continuation needs justification.
boundaries: Situated observations remain field evidence rather than collaborator profiles or universal effectiveness claims. Skill creation stays within the current authority and repository scope. Activation, recurrence, polish, and self-authored examples remain routing observations rather than evidence of authority or effectiveness. A first instruction-only attempt is useful evidence, and an unformed or resting candidate remains a valid outcome.
contract.result: One named route, the evidence that supports it, the smallest useful action, and a return condition that leaves the original work easy to resume.

receivingUse.job: Material work reveals a reusable collaboration move, friction in an active skill, a promising skill billet, overlapping skill territory, or a repeated meta-level pass whose continuation needs justification.
receivingUse.materialResult: One named route, the evidence that supports it, the smallest useful action, and a return condition that leaves the original work easy to resume.
receivingUse.completion: The receiving collaborator can locate the semantic source, work within its boundaries, and recognize the material result.

standing.evidenceMaturity: Repository-maintained portable contract with source-specific, revisable material-use evidence.
standing.wakeTrigger: Material use, human correction, receiving-artifact behavior, or independent evidence changes this route.

transferBoundary: This projection carries repository-local instruction yield. Current intent, repository evidence, and granted tool authority govern each activation.
